About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity ‘startup-within-Salesforce,’ following our recent acquisition. We have successfully navigated the "0 to 1" journey and are now scaling Agentforce for Supply Chain from 1 to 100. This involves moving beyond a single-stack startup architecture into a sophisticated, multi-environment global operation that serves the world’s largest enterprises and government entities.

This is a unique leadership opportunity to manage the production excellence of a high-growth AI product while balancing a complex technical landscape: from our modern Salesforce-native deployment to legacy environments and highly specialized custom deployments for global tier-one customers.

What You’ll Do

As the Director of Production Support Engineering, you will be the strategic leader and people manager for our embedded reliability organization. You will lead a high-caliber team of Lead and Principal Engineers (LMTS/PMTS) who are integrated directly into the product lifecycle.

Your challenge is one of orchestration and strategy. You will be responsible for defining the roadmap that allows us to scale our commercial Salesforce offering into a multi-region, multi-substrate powerhouse. Simultaneously, you will oversee the stability of our legacy and custom enterprise environments, ensuring our most critical customers receive "five-nines" reliability. You will also be the lead architect for our future, charting the course for Private Cloud Edition (PCE) and Government Cloud offerings that require the highest levels of security and sovereignty.

Responsibilities

Strategic Roadmap & Vision: Devise and champion a long-term infrastructure strategy that balances rapid AI product innovation with the rigorous demands of enterprise-grade reliability and global scale.
People Leadership: Manage and grow a world-class team of Production Support Engineers. You will be responsible for technical mentorship, career development, and maintaining a high-performance, low-ego culture.
Multi-Substrate Scaling: Lead the transition to a multi-region and multi-substrate deployment model within the Salesforce commercial cloud, ensuring our "Super Agent" architecture is resilient across global geographies.
Legacy & Custom Operations: Oversee the maintenance and support of our legacy environments and bespoke customer deployments, ensuring a seamless experience for long-term partners as they transition toward our modern stack.
Compliance & Sovereignty Strategy: Act as the primary stakeholder for our Private Cloud (PCE) and Government Cloud initiatives, ensuring our infrastructure meets strict regulatory and data-residency requirements without sacrificing developer velocity.
Operational Excellence: Define and hold the team accountable to SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets. You will lead the "incident-to-insight" loop, ensuring production issues result in structural improvements to the product.
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Security leadership to align infrastructure investments with the broader business goals of the Agentforce ecosystem.
Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code.
Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.
Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably.
Critically evaluate code (Human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in Production Engineering, SRE, or Infrastructure roles, with at least 3-5 years in a formal people management capacity.
Deep Technical Roots: You must remain highly technical. You are comfortable reviewing architecture designs for Kubernetes, Terraform, and distributed databases (PostgreSQL), and you understand the operational nuances of AI/GPU workloads.
Experience at Scale: A proven track record of managing production environments through a "1 to 100" scaling phase, ideally in a multi-region or multi-cloud context.
Strategic Clarity: Demonstrated ability to articulate a complex technical vision and turn it into an actionable roadmap that stakeholders can rally behind.
Enterprise Savvy: Experience supporting "Big Iron" enterprise customers with custom deployment needs and high-compliance requirements.
High-Stakes Leadership: Proven ability to lead through major incidents and complex architectural migrations with a calm, decisive approach.
AI-Forward Mindset: Experience leveraging AI tools to optimize team workflows and a clear vision for how AI will transform the future of production support.
A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering. Using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.
Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows
Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Government/Sovereign Clouds: Direct experience navigating FedRAMP, IL5/IL6, or similar high-security compliance frameworks.
Salesforce Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with Hyperforce, Salesforce Data Cloud, or the internal mechanics of a "Private Cloud Edition."
Hybrid Infrastructure: Experience managing the bridge between public cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) and specialized enterprise environments.
Advanced Degree: M.S. in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Provide leadership for one or more Network Engineering teams or a small group delivering hyperscale L3/L4 networking and cloud connectivity. Define tactical and strategic plans, drive significant cross-group improvements in reliability, security, and cost efficiency, and communicate progress and risks to leadership. Manage elements of the budget and are accountable for meeting budget targets across the teams you lead. May have a mixed team of Network Engineers and Network Hardware Engineers, coordinating the physical network platform lifecycle (planning, sourcing, qualifying, sustaining routers/switches, optics/OLS, timing, cabling) to ensure interoperable, cost- and power-efficient components that enable reliable, secure, and compliant services at scale

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

L3/L4 Network Topologies and Overlays:

Defines multi-quarter architecture roadmap for DC fabrics, routing policy, IPv6 strategy, failure domains, and traffic engineering across regions.
Leads cross-team design reviews and modernization programs (e.g., EVPN/VXLAN/SDN upgrades); enforces MOP/rollback and verification standards.

Cloud Networking Implementation and Operations:

Standardizes VPC/VCN topologies, transit/peering, PrivateLink/service endpoints, NAT, and inter-/multi-cloud connectivity.
Optimizes L4/L7 load balancing and service-insertion at scale; enforces cost/SLO guardrails and capacity alignment.

Network Security Controls and Compliance Guardrails:

Embeds zero-trust-aligned segmentation and policy frameworks; drives rulebase lifecycle and tech-debt reduction.
Leads audit readiness and risk reduction programs with Security/GRC; implements policy-as-code and preventative controls.

Automation, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code:

Institutionalizes IaC modules/collections and GitOps; mandates code reviews, policy-as-code, testing, and safe deployment patterns (canary/auto-rollback).
Sponsors platform/tooling investments; tracks and improves DORA metrics across teams.

Monitoring, Telemetry, and SLOs:

Sets SLI/SLO policy for the group; ensures telemetry pipelines (SNMP/streaming, NetFlow/IPFIX, flow logs) support reliability, capacity, and security analytics.
Chairs capacity/performance reviews; directs right-sizing, routing optimization, and placement decisions.

Cross-Team Collaboration and Operations Excellence:

Leads cross-group incident response and complex changes; coordinates executive updates on high-importance matters.
Influences adoption of standards across adjacent orgs; negotiates with vendors and partners within budget authority.

Documentation, Reviews, and Standards:

Publishes group-level standards, reference architectures, and runbooks; ensures traceability to requirements and controls.
Operates design/change councils across teams; drives consistent documentation quality and version control.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Oversees and guides multiple teams on managing complex projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable to ensure strategic objectives are met. Serves as a role model for appropriately delegating work, setting priorities, and ensuring alignment with business needs. Coaches others on adjusting resources or project timelines in anticipation of business changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Role models leading cross-functional collaborative efforts to ensure alignment of expectations and strategic objectives. Empowers team to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to address barriers and contribute to organizational success. Drives transparency and inclusivity by modeling actively seeking, listening to, and leveraging diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

Shares problem-solving strategies across teams, providing oversight on complex operational and/or technical issues, as needed. Coaches teams on analyzing highly complex data and/or information to identify solutions to ambiguous issues, and provides direction on identifying root causes to prevent recurrence of issues.

Continuous Learning:

Pursues strategic learning opportunities to maintain expertise and apply best practices at the organizational level. Creates opportunities for team members and leaders to build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to build innovative skills. Identifies skill gap trends across the organization, and upholds a culture that places significant emphasis on sharing knowledge and pursuing learning opportunities that advance the organization. Evaluates efficiency of learning strategies and recommends adjustments as needed.

Continuous Improvement:

Empowers team to own the development and implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Coaches teams to gain buy-in for ideas and to seek feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement. Prioritizes and reviews the roadmap of improvement initiatives to ensure alignment with strategic direction and maximize return on investments.

Performance and Development:

Serves as a role model for driving performance across teams through tailored feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Drives consistency in the application of talent development procedures and socializes performance expectations across the organization. Ensures that individual development goals are aligned with organizational strategic initiatives. Collaborates with HR to implement talent strategy through hiring and promotion processes.

new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA's DOCA organization is scaling rapidly, and operational excellence across our development toolchain is critical to our success. We are seeking an experienced Director to lead the teams and initiatives that power our engineering engine — spanning DevOps infrastructure, software integration, AI-assisted development tools, and the end-to-end BlueField user experience.

In this role, you will directly manage the DevOps and Integration teams while driving the adoption and expansion of AI productivity tools across DOCA engineering. You will also own the BlueField user experience — from out-of-box installation and provisioning through field deployments — ensuring that developers, partners, and data center operators can get productive with our platform from day one.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead and grow the DOCA DevOps team: CI/CD pipelines, lab infrastructure, build systems, release automation, and developer tooling.
Own the DOCA Integration team: multi-component integration workflows, cross-team handoffs, validation gates, and release readiness for the DOCA/BF software stack.
Drive AI tools strategy across DOCA R&D — evaluating, adopting, and operationalizing AI-assisted coding, testing, documentation, and review tools to accelerate engineering productivity.
Own the end-to-end BlueField user experience: out-of-box installation, provisioning, firmware/software lifecycle, documentation quality, and deployment workflows for DPU customers and internal teams.
Define and track benchmarks for DevOps maturity, integration stability, AI tool adoption, and BlueField UX quality across release cycles.
Mentor team leads and senior engineers build career paths and scale the function to meet DOCA's growing portfolio.

What We Need To See

B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a combination of practical experience equivalent to these degrees.
12+ overall years of professional experience in software engineering organizations, with deep exposure to DevOps, integration, or infrastructure software.
Minimum 6+ years managing R&D engineering teams, including direct management of team leads or senior engineers.
Strong hands-on technical background: Linux environments, CI/CD systems, build automation, container/virtualization infrastructure, and system-level software.
Proven track record improving complex integration pipelines, release readiness processes, and developer productivity workflows.
Experience evaluating and rolling out AI/ML-based developer tools (e.g., code generation, automated testing, documentation assistants) in engineering organizations.
Excellent communication and multi-functional leadership — able to align engineering leaders and turn ambiguous operational or usability problems into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Direct familiarity with DOCA, BlueField DPUs, SmartNICs, or data center infrastructure software.
Experience improving out-of-the-box product experience, provisioning workflows, or customer-facing deployment documentation for complex hardware/software platforms.
Background leading DevOps or platform engineering at scale in a large R&D organization shipping system-level software.
Track record of adopting AI coding assistants, automated PR review, or AI-based QA tools in a real production engineering context.
